label: HOME screen (390px)
verdict:
VERDICT: PASS

PILL-FLOATS: Detached floating pill with visible gaps on left, right, and bottom edges — not a full-width bar.

PILL-GLASS: Reads as translucent glass with bright white fill, subtle border, and soft drop shadow against the background.

ACTIVE-TAB: Yes — dark filled circle behind the Home icon with white glyph and bold label; active tab is unmistakable.

LABELS: All three labels (Home / Bookings / Profile) are present, legible, and adequately sized.

CLEARANCE: No content hidden or clipped; footer links ("Privacy · Terms", version) end well above the pill.

CONTENT: Doctor cards render fully with ₹300 fee visible above the pill; horizontal card partially cut is a scroll affordance, not a defect.

NITPICKS:
1. minor — Second doctor/hospital card bleeds off the right edge with no visual hint (fade/peek); could look like clipping to first-time users.
2. minor — " acidity" chip is truncated at the right edge; consider full label or fade mask.
3. minor — Glass effect is subtle to the point of near-solid white; a slightly stronger translucency/blur would better match the Practo reference.

label: BOOKINGS screen (390px)
verdict:
VERDICT: PASS

PILL-FLOATS: Yes — the pill is detached with clear gaps from left/right/bottom edges, not a full-width bar.

PILL-GLASS: Yes — bright near-white fill, subtle rounded border, and a soft drop shadow give it a glassy read (though the fill is fairly opaque).

ACTIVE-TAB: Yes — Bookings has a dark filled circle behind its icon, and the bold label makes the active state obvious.

LABELS: Yes — Home, Bookings, Profile are all readable; Bookings is bolded as active.

CLEARANCE: No content is hidden or clipped; the pill sits in empty space below the booking card.

CONTENT: Main content (booking card with doctor, date/time, status badge) is fully visible, but there's no primary action button — acceptable for a list screen, though a list-only screen leaves large empty space.

NITPICKS:
1. (minor) Large dead space below the single booking card — could benefit from a help/secondary action or empty-state guidance.
2. (minor) The pill's fill looks more solid white than translucent; increasing background blur/transparency would strengthen the glass effect.
3. (minor) "Change" button next to the masked phone number has unclear affordance — it's ambiguous whether it changes the number or the filter.

label: PROFILE screen (390px)
verdict:
VERDICT: PASS

PILL-FLOATS: Yes — the pill is detached with visible gaps on left, right, and bottom edges, not a full-width bar.

PILL-GLASS: Weakly — it has a rounded shape with soft shadow and subtle border, but the fill reads nearly flat white rather than distinctly translucent glass.

ACTIVE-TAB: Yes — a dark filled black circle sits behind the Profile icon, and the bold "Profile" label makes the active state obvious.

LABELS: Yes — Home, Bookings, and Profile are all rendered and legible.

CLEARANCE: Yes — no content is hidden or clipped by the pill; safe spacing is maintained.

CONTENT: Yes — main content (guest card, settings rows) is fully visible with clear separation above the pill; profile has no primary action, which is acceptable.

NITPICKS:
1. The glass effect is barely perceptible (fill looks opaque white) — minor.
2. Large empty whitespace between settings and version footer makes the screen feel sparse — minor.
3. The "Sign in or create account" tap target sits inside the card but has no chevron-style button treatment beyond the inline link — minor.
